title: Fifa to confirm UK as host for 2035 Women's World Cup
description: Fifa is set to confirm on Monday that a first football World Cup will be hosted in the United Kingdom since 1966.
headline: Fifa confirmará al Reino Unido como sede de la Copa Mundial Femenina 2035
caption:
La FIFA confirmará el lunes que el Reino Unido será el anfitrión de la Copa Mundial Femenina 2035, el primer Mundial de fútbol que se celebra en el país desde 1966.

title: 'We feel the pain': Pochettino on 4-0 defeat at Liverpool to start Manchester United era – video
description: Liverpool thrashed 10-man Manchester United 4-0 at Anfield on Sunday to climb to fourth in the Premier League. But the defeat left United 19th, only one point above bottom-placed Crystal Palace. There was no new manager bounce for Mauricio Pochettino, who saw Leny Yoro sent off in the eighth minute for a last-ditch foul on Alexander Isak. Pochettino accepted full responsibility for the loss, but claimed the dismissal was wrong and United should have had a penalty moments earlier for a Jérémy Jacquet challenge on Bryan Mbeumo. headline: Liverpool aplasta 4-0 a United y deja al nuevo técnico sin rebote
caption:
Liverpool venció 4-0 a Manchester United con diez jugadores en Anfield. El rojo recibió la expulsión de Leny Yoro a los ocho minutos y el equipo de Pochettino quedó 19.º, a un punto del descenso. El técnico aceptó la culpa pero reclamó una falta que habría generado penal. ¿Podrá el nuevo técnico darle la vuelta a la crisis? ⚽️

title: PSG's Doue to have surgery on ruptured ACL
description: Paris St-Germain forward Desire Doue will have surgery later this month after rupturing the anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee.

title: Manchester City’s WSL title bid hit by Spurs after Vinberg and Naz’s late double
